item: SCOPE §11.3 item 7: LIVE budget $200 of settled cash (Camden, 2026-10-17); deposits never raise it
verdict: EVIDENCED (budget mechanics); arming remains Camden's own act and is not evidenced here
pin_to_commit_note: Between the pin and this commit, scripts/mode_config.py changed only bound_buys refusal labels (below_one_share, PR #321), and exec/live_loop.py, exec/paper_loop.py and ops/persist_state.sh changed only for 057 D-12 (the ops-state push is retried and a persist failure halts with a named reason). No cap, budget or settled-cash logic changed; the cap lines below have the same text as at the pin, at new line numbers.
claims: The LIVE cap is a code constant: MAX_LIVE_BUDGET_USD = 200.0, used as LIVE_CAP.
A profile above $200 halts before broker login (validate_live_budget; protected test 200 allowed, 200.01 refused, zero logins).
Provisioning accepts only a $200 live_fidelity profile template (PILOT_BUDGET_USD).
Each run's budget is min(profile budget, settled cash, $200): settled cash only, never buying power or unsettled deposits.
Settled cash above $200 never raises the budget: on every pinned preview run settled cash was $201.22 and the budget was $200.00.
An unsettled deposit is a normal refusal, and an attributable deposit is applied once and is never counted as gain.

tests.mutation_note: Mutant 'exceeds 200 cap' (tests/mutation/run_057_q137_mutants.py) is part of the item 1 mutation-suite refresh at the arming SHA; it was not re-run here.

runtime_observations.source: private ops-state live_fidelity/runs.jsonl (fields copied; no account identifiers)

limitations: No real deposit has been made since the pin; 'deposits never raise it' rests on the code, the tests, and settled cash above $200 not raising the budget.
Preview mode only: no LIVE order has been placed (place_calls = 0 on every run).
The LIVE profile itself is an unreadable private secret; its $200 value is inferred from budget = 200.0 with settled cash 201.22, plus the pre-login $200 refusal.
